svg.title: Next: open the stations and finish the lines
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map of the end-of-2026 target. New orange Rust stations sit right on the track at the Cache, Vault, Post office and Ledger, wrapped in Opening soon tape, with the old wooden huts still beside them. Crab crews lay track on the Messages, Responses and Chat lines after the split. The Gate and Router are still wooden, with a sign saying they come after the lines.
svg.text: Next: open the stations and finish the lines
New Rust stations open on the track, the old huts close, and the big three lines get track.
